title: New Iranian supreme leader 'safe and sound' amid rumours surrounding wellbeing
summary: The son of Iran's president has said the new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei is "safe and sound" following reports the late ayatollah's son was injured in a strike that killed his father and his wife on the first day of the war. Khamenei has not been seen since his nomination, sparking rumours regarding his wellbeing.
